tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Return the npm install command and buildless CDN import for the MachVive package (@machfivetechchicago/machvive-webmcp-ai).

manager.description: Package manager, or "cdn" for a no-build module script

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List the MachVive web components with their tag, import subpath, and purpose.

tools.name: magnet_describe
tools.description: Describe the "MachVive" enquiry form: what it asks, what it collects, and whether it can schedule a meeting. Call this first.

tools.name: magnet_options
tools.description: List the allowed choices for one of the form's multiple-choice fields.

tools.name: magnet_start
tools.description: Open the enquiry form with answers filled in, so the visitor can review and submit. Known fields: product_interest, name, email. This does NOT submit — the visitor confirms. Fields you leave out are asked of the visitor. Extra keys beyond the known fields are allowed and travel with the lead, which is how context like a campaign or source id is passed through.

enum: Building with it and need help

name.description: Who are we talking with? First and last name.

tools.name: magnet_status
tools.description: Check how far the visitor has got with the enquiry form: whether it has been opened, engaged with, which step they are on, and whether they submitted.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the MachVive documentation on machvive.com and return matching sections with a URL, heading, and excerpt.
